blocks.text: The western basalt plains grasslands are one of Australia's most threatened ecosystems. Iramoo Wildflower Grassland is a remnant of this ancient landscape — a living archive of plants, soils and stories that have shaped this Country for millennia.
The GREEN Lab has strong links to the three grasslands that are managed by the Cairnlea Conservation Reserves Committee of Management:

[Iramoo Wildflower Grassland Reserve] (https://friendsofiramoograsslands.wordpress.com/iramoo-wildflower-grassland-reserve/)
[Featherheads Wildflower Grassland](https://friendsofiramoograsslands.wordpress.com/featherheads-wildflower-grassland/)
Pimelea Wildflower Grassland (https:\friendsofiramoograsslands.wordpress.com\pimelea-wildflower-reserve\)

Kangaroo Grass (Themeda triandra)
Spiny Rice-flower (Pimelea spinescens)
Button Wrinklewort (Rutidosis leptorrhynchoides)
Matted Flax-lily (Dianella amoena)
Golden Sun Moth (Synemon plana)
